sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production seamless square 2D dungeon FLOOR TEXTURE for hand-painted cat adventure RPG. Pure top-down orthographic view, flat walkable surface, no perspective horizon, no walls/objects/characters/UI/text. Painterly ink-edged details, rich subtle material variation, evenly lit with no strong directional cast shadow. Texture should tile seamlessly on all four edges and remain readable under player characters and bright attack telegraphs. Avoid obvious blank geometric blocks or flat solid-color areas. Opaque full canvas. RIMEGLASS RESERVOIR: ancient slate flagstone path encased beneath translucent blue ice, visible frosty silver cracks, pale snow dust in joints, tiny trapped bubbles and subtle cyan glacial mineral veins. Mostly medium blue-grey stone with ice covering it, enough neutral walkable surface. A frozen machinery cavern floor, cold and beautiful, not a pool of water.
